description: Land Acquisition - Olaittoduvai, Thoddaveli, Mannar D/S Division, Mannar District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific lands (Olaittoduvaikani and Thoddakani) for public purposes. It contains detailed descriptions of the properties, including location, extent, present use, and claimant information. The content primarily deals with land acquisition matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves government acquisition of land and property rights.
